title: Dressing Quantities per Shipment — Wound Care Supply Program Coverage Criteria
content:
# Dressing quantities per shipment — Wound Care Supply Program

Coverage criteria for the number of dressings a shipment may carry.

## Criteria

1. **Quantity of one item.** The dressings of one item a refill may ship for a wound are the item's weekly maximum times the supply days divided by 7, rounded down, or the change frequency on the written order for those days when that is lower; a shipment never covers more than one month.
2. **Secondary cover dressing.** A primary dressing listed as needing a secondary cover dressing ships only when the written order also names a secondary cover dressing, which is supplied under its own weekly maximum.
3. **More frequent changes.** Changes more frequent than the weekly maximum are covered only when a medical record with the purpose over-limit justification, documenting heavy drainage or infection, is dated no more than the tier's over-limit record interval, in calendar days, before the ship date; without it the extra dressings ship only under the advance notice of financial liability rules at the item's cash price.
4. **Surgical or debrided wounds.** On tiers where coverage requires surgery or debridement, dressings are covered only for a wound whose initial qualification record documents that it was caused or treated by surgery or debrided.
5. **Self-pay.** On the Wound Care Self-Pay Program dressings are sold at the item's cash price up to the written order's quantity.
6. **Replacements.** A replacement never exceeds the units of the shipment it replaces.

## Worked quantities (30 supply days, using the item schedule's weekly figures)

| Item | Weekly maximum | Weekly maximum times 30, divided by 7 | Rounded down |
|---|---|---|---|
| A6196 | 7 | 30 | 30 |
| A6209 | 3 | 12.86 | 12 |
| A6402 | 21 | 90 | 90 |

*Order lower than the limit (hypothetical).* A written order for item A6209 calls for 8 changes over those 30 days. The order's frequency, 8, is lower than 12, so 8 dressings ship.

## Over-limit record (hypothetical figures)

Ship date 2026-08-20, over-limit record interval of 30 days: an over-limit justification record dated 2026-07-21 supports the more frequent changes; a record dated 2026-07-20 does not.
